author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಹೊಸಕೊರಳ ಲಯದೊಡನೆ ಅನುಭವದ ತಾಳವಿರೆ
ಹಸಿಮನಸ ತುಂಬುವುದು ನಾದಸಂಭ್ರಮವು
ಕಸಿಯುತಿರೆ ಮನಗಳನು ಚಿತ್ತಶುದ್ಧಿಯ ಮಾಡಿ
ಎಸೆನಿನ್ನ ಕಸಗಳನು ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: When the rhythm of a young voice keeps time with experience,
the joy of music fills the tender mind;
as it steals hearts and makes the mind pure,
throw out your rubbish, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: When a fresh young voice is matched with the measure of experience, music fills an open heart with joy. Let it win you over and cleanse your mind, and use it to throw out the clutter within.
